basis: Original 50-question discussion reconciled with subsequent voice answers and project wiki. Partial means direction established but an explicit detail remains unresolved. No new answers inferred from proposed architecture alone.

questions.detail: Voice-first agent throughout the day; background work surfaces artifacts and interactive interfaces.
Coding/self-extension is first. Other first-priority tasks beyond the bootstrap are not ranked.
Replace the user's ChatGPT app workflows for text, voice and computer use. Over time, April should handle much of the manual prompting currently done in Cursor, which remains an integration target.
Voice-first unified application; chat is secondary; artifact workspace alongside voice.
Background responsibilities and context-aware surfacing, based on priority and need for action.
Personal use first. Later, anyone with a Cloudflare account and a MacBook should be able to use April. Distribution/provisioning details remain engineering work.
Platform-agnostic core; native adapters start on Mac. Web then native Android; Windows/Linux later.
Unified April experience confirmed; allowable UI differences between operating systems remain open.
Core portability is required; client timing and supported Linux environments remain unspecified.
Offline typed chat queues requests; no initial offline voice or local intelligence. Eager sync to authoritative Cloudflare.
No headless CLI/API product interface initially; deferred. Internal service APIs are not excluded.
Plugin architecture is a major direction across integrations, specialists and artifacts. Detailed third-party contracts/trust/distribution are explicitly deferred.
Deep native integration required; exact first read/control workflows are unspecified.
Coding targets April repos on GitHub; native apps to inspect/control are not named.
Only explicitly shared desktop content initially. Broader app awareness/control later; Codex as north star; deep dive deferred.
API versus UI choice is explicitly deferred per integration; plugin contracts should allow either. No universal preference required now.
Computer-use details, including screenshot/input fallback, are explicitly deferred to a Codex-inspired deep dive. Initial observation only sees explicitly shared content.
Summoning voice preserves focus; whether automation may take foreground control while user works is open.
Approval is centralized; behavior for ambiguous UI targets still needs definition.
Quiet inspectable memory chosen; what app content can be captured and retained is not defined.
Primary interaction modality.
Configurable held key starts persistent session; dismiss by speech or double-press. Wake word later.
Natural barge-in required; initial OpenAI realtime direction, provider-portable behavior.
Microphone plus system audio; meetings and music identification are example tasks. Session controls/retention remain separate.
Explicitly started sessions continue with workspace window closed, with a visible listening/capture indicator. Sleep/termination behavior remains open.
English and Hindi, including primarily English with occasional mixed Hindi.
Not initially available.
Reference transcription may lag. Live spoken response/interruption quality, acceptable delays and resource/cost tradeoffs still need targets.
Research/learning wiki and personal artifacts are envisioned; initial content mix is not prioritized.
Background autonomy desired; rules for maintaining versus proposing wiki edits are not specified.
Obsidian-inspired unified workspace; DOCX preview is sufficient initially, not full Word editing.
Markdown, DOCX preview, JavaScript source and interactive artifacts requested; other types can be phased.
Yes, inside unified April; no required separate Obsidian app.
Actively ask the user to clarify conflicts before choosing; correct the wiki and continue affected work from the corrected version. Provenance and revision mechanics remain design work.

All persistent files and both public/private vaults live in cloud storage as source of truth. Local folders/copies synchronize eagerly; offline pending edits reconcile later. Storage does not grant private agent access.
Broad autonomy for simpler proactive work, including research; substantial feature work needs discussion. Additional action classes can be discovered during use; detailed rules deferred.
Private-vault approval uses explicit overlay click and initial production follows PR approval. Additional mandatory approval categories are intentionally discovered during use.

Central approval model learns decisions and auto-approves within policy; repeated unnecessary prompts can be reviewed into default allowances. Private grants end with task. Enforcement/revocation details remain.
Non-blocking new/edited artifact indicators and context-aware delivery are chosen. Detailed activity/live execution presentation can be designed later.
Quiet storage/use with inspection and tuning; query engine plus parallel memory model; research deferred.
Financial/medical excluded from ordinary memory with provisional task access; any other exclusions not specified.
User asks April conversationally to fix noticed mistakes. Recovery mechanisms such as history/undo are implementation design rather than an unanswered interaction preference.

One continuous user-facing thread across interactions; April internally branches and organizes context as needed. Conversations do not belong to vaults. Cross-device protocol and context-routing mechanics remain implementation work.
Yes: requests from the phone may use an online, authorized Mac. Remote routing, device choice and unavailable-device behavior remain implementation work.

Approved cloud tasks continue if the Mac disconnects, including private-file tasks within the existing task-scoped grant. Most work is cloud-first; local integration steps need a reachable device. Key custody/enforcement details remain design work.
No strong language preference; choose based on product constraints, efficiency, fluid interaction and portability. Final stack requires engineering evaluation.
Efficient resource use and fluid/non-janky interactions matter more than shipping sooner. Numeric budgets and minimum hardware remain to be defined.
Cloudflare $5 base-plan target plus $20/month AI soft nudge; ask about higher spend but keep working. Actual usage costs and overrun safeguards need validation.
Mac conversation, then coding April itself, dev deployments and GitHub PRs; discuss big features before implementation.
Wake word, memory-provider research, other repos, web/Android later. Complete v1 scope boundary still needs refinement.

resume: Continue architecture refinement. Cloud-first tasks, cloud storage for all files, lightweight Mac client and approved task continuation after disconnect are confirmed. Do not reopen the offline-Mac/private-task question. Key custody, revocation and local-device availability handling remain implementation work.
technicalFollowups: Confirmed: approved cloud tasks, including private-file tasks under existing task-scoped access, continue if the Mac disconnects. Next: specify key custody, revocation and device-unavailable handling; all persistent files are cloud-backed.
Engineering evaluation: unified voice overlay and artifact workspace, plugin-ready architecture, low resource use and fluid interactions on the verified M2 Pro / 16 GB Mac.
Private grants: task-end expiry is decided; specify revocation, terminal-state handling, derived-context cleanup, encryption keys and recovery.
Sync: preserve both conflicting edits and ask the user is decided; specify lineage, resolution propagation, deletion and reconnection.
Coding bootstrap: Cloudflare execution, April-only GitHub repositories, dev/PR/user approval flow are decided; validate macOS packaging/native tests and exact release evidence.
Deferred deep dives: plugin contracts/trust, per-integration API versus UI, Codex-inspired computer use and memory systems including Supermemory.
Operational implementation: accurate cost tracking and non-blocking $20 AI nudge, task retry/cancellation, recovery history and permission enforcement.
